# git-wire

## Type Aliases

### ReceivePack

```ts
type ReceivePack =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "ok";
      updates: readonly GitRefUpdate[];
      capabilities: readonly string[];
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "probe";
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "invalid";
      reason: "unparsable" | "push-cert" | "too-many";
    }>;
```

The decoded receive-pack command section; pack bytes remain unopened.
